description: Huntington Bancshares Incorporated is a multi-state diversified regional bank holding company organized under Maryland law in 1966 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, which through the Bank is committed to making people's lives better, helping businesses thrive and strengthening the communities it serves, and has been servicing the financial needs of its customers since 1866. Through its subsidiaries it provides full-service commercial and consumer deposit, lending and other banking and financial services, including payments, mortgage banking, direct and indirect consumer financing, investment banking, capital markets, advisory, equipment financing, distribution finance, investment management, trust, brokerage, insurance and other financial products and services. As of December 31, 2025 it operated more than 1,000 branches in 14 states, and following the completion of its merger with Cadence Bank on February 1, 2026 it operates nearly 1,400 branches in 21 states.
